apps.name: ManicEMU
apps.subtitle: All-in-one retro game emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: All-in-one retro game emulator for iOS, bringing console, arcade, computer, and mobile Java systems into one clean app with saves, cheats, custom skins, RetroAchievements, and more.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Improved 3DS performance
- Nimbus in Artic Base now supports the latest Pretendo
- Improved Home Menu performance on the Azahar core
- Fixed Wii pointer behavior for affected users
- Added MeloCafe Link support
- iPad now supports windowed apps
- Redesigned the SNES skin
- Added skin fallback: iPad can use iPhone skins
- Support for iPhone Duo
- Fixed AirPlay not working on iOS 27 or later
- Added BitBop, a new sister app to Manic EMU for retro game music
- Other bug fixes and improvements
